segments.text: It's Crash and Coco! Get them!
Okay, okay, okay. Now, let's battle!
Hey, we use Super Kick a lot. Let's use...
I can't squeeze my hand in it.
Snakey? Is that what you named it?
You actually named a monster Snakey?
I'd put it in a museum.
I think I'd just, um, pick a pinch.
I'm taking a quick rest after I kick him to bits.
I can pinch him with my Bazooka.
We're supposed to be annoying you.
I guess you want it to be the hard way.
You mean you want to battle your hardest?
I want a head while we're doing that.
I'm not using any word attacks.
It's supposed to knock her out.
I'm learning to be the Beam Master of the Super Family.
Uh, well he is, but I'm learning to be second in command.
We're not those things that sprout up in your garden.
Just you and me, Makuta and Colin, Destroyer.
Hit me. Good thing I jumped in time.
I don't have a favorite color.
Attack her with the hyper beam.
Oh, nobody makes fun of my dance!
